### Where rendering happens

| Client or service | Role | Trade-off |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Browser client | Edit, collaborate, and render an execution-free Markdown draft | No installation; does not run code |
| Local companion | Run installed Quarto, R, and Python | Full local toolchain; requires pairing |
| Server | Synchronize source, history, and shared assets | Stable shared state; performs no execution |
